visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight brown hair and bangs stands in a brightly lit indoor studio. She wears a light blue t-shirt and small silver earrings. She holds a black and pink packet of 'SUP Creatine Gummies' in her left hand, gesturing with her right as she speaks directly to the camera. The background is a soft, out-of-focus home setting featuring a warm yellow lamp and a shelf with small figurines. (2) The scene cuts to a gym environment where a person in white sneakers and dark shorts performs weighted squats and medicine ball rotations. The lighting is bright and industrial, with gym equipment like treadmills visible in the background. White captions appear at the bottom of the frame over the movement. (3) A brief close-up shows a fresh, orange slab of raw salmon with distinct fat lines on a grey surface, followed by a cut back to the woman in the blue shirt. She continues to hold the product and gesture, her facial expressions animated with clear mouth movements and squinted eyes for emphasis. (4) Transition to B-roll of women exercising in a gym; one in a purple sports top performs barbell squats, and another in a black top runs on a treadmill. The camera follows their motion with a slight handheld feel. Large white subtitles continue to cycle at the bottom. (5) The woman in the blue shirt is shown again, holding the creatine package. She explains the product's benefits while her hands move rhythmically to her speech. The lighting remains consistent, highlighting the texture of her hair and the product packaging. (6) A sequence of B-roll depicts a professional woman in a beige blazer working on a laptop by a large window with a city view. Close-up shots of hands typing on a laptop and the woman holding a white coffee cup follow. The lighting is natural and soft, coming from the large window. (7) Returning to the main creator, she holds up a hand gesture while discussing dosage. Finally, she opens the packet, takes out a small, round pink gummy, places it in her mouth, and chews with a smile while variety text overlays appear above her head.

(4) [Subtitle]: 在此之前我必須要幫被誤會已久的肌酸說說話. (5) [Subtitle]: 肌酸並不是只能幫助長肌肉. (6) [Subtitle]: 它也可以提升你的腦力. (7) [Subtitle]: 肌酸是人體可以自行合成. (8) [Subtitle]: 你也可以從食物中攝取. (9) [Subtitle]: 它可以幫助細胞快速產生能量ATP.
